body.purpose: Inherited page base (Archivo 500, cream on brown-950). No visible paragraph ships in it yet.

social-pill.purpose: Only call-to-action text: Instagram / X / Email pill labels, Archivo 700.

fineprint.purpose: Spaced-caps uppercase copyright line under the dock, Archivo 600, 0.18em tracking.

shadows.name: plaque-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter drop-shadow seating the logo plaque on the door plate, following the lockup silhouette.

shadows.name: pill-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts social pills off the photographic plate.

shadows.name: fineprint-scrim
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow legibility scrim for fineprint over photography; not elevation.

motion.name: spill
motion.purpose: Warm light breathing over the plate's lit edge via .door::after radial-gradient(50% 65% at 91% 42%, rgba(255,205,105,0.18), transparent 62%). Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pill-state
motion.value: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; hover translateY(-1px)
motion.purpose: Social pill hover response. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Social Pill
components.description: Cream-outlined translucent brown pill with inline SVG icon and one-word label; the page's only interactive component.
components.html: Instagram
components.css: .ds-social-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(247,234,208,0.34); background: rgba(29,16,10,0.82); color: #f7ead0; text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(29,16,10,0.30); transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-social-pill svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: none; } .ds-social-pill:hover { background: rgba(43,26,18,0.96); border-color: rgba(242,193,78,0.8); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-social-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c14e; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Social Pill Dock
components.description: Bottom-center dock: wrapping centered pill row above the spaced-caps fineprint.
components.html:
InstagramXEmail

components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw - 28px); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dock-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; } .ds-dock-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(247,234,208,0.34); background: rgba(29,16,10,0.82); color: #f7ead0; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(29,16,10,0.30); transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-dock-pill:hover { background: rgba(43,26,18,0.96); border-color: rgba(242,193,78,0.8); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-dock-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c14e; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dock-fineprint { margin: 0; color: #f7ead0; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 1px 10px rgba(29,16,10,0.9), 0 0 22px rgba(29,16,10,0.65); text-align: center; }

components.name: Logo Plaque
components.description: Real supplied logo lockup mounted on the door plate; desktop left/top placement. Artwork is binding and never redrawn (image src omitted here as a local asset).
components.html: Night Clerk Cans logo lockup (assets/nightclerk-logo-lockup.png, 1024x635)
components.css: .ds-plaque { width: min(44%, 620px); filter: drop-shadow(0 22px 30px rgba(29,16,10,0.38)); background: #2b1a12; color: #f7ead0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 24px; } .ds-plaque-note { font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .ds-plaque { width: min(76vw, 340px); } }

components.name: Door Plate with Spill
components.description: Full-bleed photographic door section (min-height 100dvh) with the animated warm spill overlay; brown-950 fallback ground.
components.html: Full-bleed door plate; mobile crop swaps at 820px
components.css: .ds-door { position: relative; min-height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; background: #1d100a; color: #f7ead0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-door::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(50% 65% at 91% 42%, rgba(255,205,105,0.18), transparent 62%); animation: ds-spill 5.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-spill { 0%,100% { opacity: 0.65; } 48% { opacity: 1; } 52% { opacity: 0.78; } 56% { opacity: 0.95; } } .ds-door-note { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 24px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-door::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Fineprint
components.description: Spaced-caps cream copyright line legible over photography via brown text-shadow scrim.
components.css: .ds-fineprint { margin: 0; color: #f7ead0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 1px 10px rgba(29,16,10,0.9), 0 0 22px rgba(29,16,10,0.65); text-align: center; background: #1d100a; padding: 12px; }

narrative.overview: The shipped page is not a centered logo on a solid ground. It is a full-bleed photographic motel door, ajar with warm light spilling out, covering the whole first viewport (min-height: 100dvh). The supplied logo lockup is mounted on that door as its plaque, and a single pill dock sits bottom-center. Nothing else competes: no headline in web type, no card, no form. Archivo carries all live web type, in medium through bold, over a five-color palette lifted from the logo itself. Text is scarce by design; the mark and the plate do the talking.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed door plate (object-fit: cover, centered) as the only background; brown-950 is the fallback ground behind it
Real logo lockup as plaque — never redrawn, never typeset as a substitute
One component family: cream-outlined social pills on translucent dark brown, docked bottom-center with a spaced-caps fineprint line
Mustard is an accent of response (focus ring, hover border), red an accent of selection — neither floods a surface
One slow warm-light "spill" animation over the plate's lit edge; everything else moves only on hover

rules.name: The Five-Color Rule
rules.body: Live CSS uses only brown-950, brown-900, cream, mustard, and red, plus alpha variants of them and one warm spill glow (rgba(255, 205, 105, 0.18)). A new surface introduces no new hue; it reuses these or an alpha of them.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Mustard and red appear only as response or inside supplied artwork — focus, hover border, selection. Neither is ever a background fill for a live surface.

rules.name: The Imagery-Carries-Display Rule
rules.body: No webfont headline is set on this page. If a future surface needs display type, it must be decided and documented then — this system does not canonize the plate's or logo's lettering as a type token.

rules.name: The Brown Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow, drop-shadow, and text-shadow is brown-950 at an alpha. Never black, never gray, never a colored glow — except the spill, which is light, not shadow.

rules.name: The Spill Rule
rules.body: One radial warm glow (50% 65% at 91% 42%, rgba(255, 205, 105, 0.18) fading to transparent at 62%) breathes over the plate's lit edge on a 5.5s ease-in-out infinite loop. It is the page's only ambient motion and the first thing reduced-motion removes.

dos: Do build first viewports as a full-bleed plate with the real logo mounted on it — plaque at left: 6% / top: 30% / min(44%, 620px) desktop, centered top: 7% / min(76vw, 340px) at ≤820px.
Do reuse the five tokens and their alphas only (brown-950, brown-900, cream, mustard, red); keep mustard to focus/hover response and red to selection and artwork.
Do set live type in Archivo 500–700, cream on brown, with weight, case, and letter-spacing doing the separation work.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum height and the focus state as the 3px mustard outline at 3px offset.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: kill the spill animation and pill transitions, exactly as shipped.
Do derive every shadow from brown-950 at an alpha.
donts: Don't redraw, re-typeset, or substitute the logo lockup, and don't float it on a solid-color panel or card.
Don't add a centered-logo-on-solid splash, a headline in web type, or any component family beyond the pill without documenting a system change here first.
Don't introduce gray, pure black/white, or a sixth hue for UI chrome.
Don't remove or restyle the mustard focus outline, and don't animate anything ambient besides the single spill — and never under reduced motion.
Don't ship placeholder social destinations (href="#", empty mailto:) as if they were final; they are owner-replaceable stubs, not a design decision.
